fix: Add `evolve inbox add` (flags or a JSON file on stdin) that validates the item against the one schema the readers already use (inboxmover's dispatchability and triage parsing), refuses a duplicate id or an unknown dependency, stamps created_at, and writes the file atomically. Document it in runtime-reference.md as the only way to file an item; the console and the retrospective's carryover minting call it (or its library function) instead of writing JSON.

summary: `evolve inbox` offers batches, quarantine, ack-fingerprint and consume; `evolve inbox-mover` offers claim, promote and recover-orphans. Nothing creates an item, so the console, retrospectives and operators hand-write .evolve/inbox/<ts>-<id>.json with no schema validation, id uniqueness check or dependency check at write time. Found 2026-09-28 while routing every control through the published interfaces (the operator rule: a control our interfaces cannot do is a defect to fix, never to script around).
title: Filing an inbox item has no evolve interface: every item is hand-written JSON
